subject: Order form + DPA: SCCs routing, fallback model & EU hosting clause
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novus Health Legal <legal@novushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Draft redlines – DPA and SCCs routing for EU customers

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached are Novus's proposed redlines to Redwood's DPA (Novus_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf). Two items we need a clear answer on before procurement will sign: 1) the SCCs routing paragraph — Novus needs committed language that EU traffic will not be routed outside the EU except for fallback to a lower-tier model and only under documented outage conditions; and 2) an explicit fallback model/ordering in the Order Form so our compliance team can confirm data residency expectations.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can add: (a) an SCCs routing clause that requires prior notice + 7-day window before non-EU routing, and (b) an Order Form appendix naming the fallback model variants and their encryption/KMS treatment?

Claire
Legal & Contracts
Novus Health

Attachments: Novus_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft redlines – DPA and SCCs routing for EU customers

Hi Claire — thanks for the redlines and for surfacing the two asks. High level answers below, and I'm looping in Ben (contracts) and Evelyn (security/compliance) to confirm technical controls and Order Form text.

- SCCs routing: we can accept an SCCs routing paragraph that commits to EU-only routing as a default and describes a fallback path. However we cannot commit to a 7-day notice for all operational fallbacks (that blocks incident response). Proposal: add a two-track fallback regime: (i) planned maintenance/non-emergency migration = 7-day notice and opt-out; (ii) emergency outage fallback = immediate routing to pre-approved fallback models with post-incident notification within 48 hours and retention/processing limits described in the DPA appendix.

- Order Form appendix: we can list fallback model variants and their quantization/latency implications, and we can specify that fallback models are operated with the same encryption-at-rest policy and KMS binding unless otherwise noted. Evelyn — can you confirm the KMS/crypto note below? Ben — if that sounds OK, we'll produce a short Order Form appendix to attach to the signature set.

Next steps:
1) Evelyn to confirm technical wording for KMS/crypto and the retention/processing limits for emergency fallback.
2) Ben to draft the Order Form appendix and a DPA appendix with the two-track fallback language.
3) We'll circulate for Novus legal review and get procurement dates.

Markus
VP, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novushealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft redlines – DPA and SCCs routing for EU customers

Claire / Markus — attaching a draft Order Form appendix and a short DPA appendix (sccs-fallback-draft.md) that implements Markus's two-track approach and enumerates the fallback models. Key calls in my draft: 1) fallback models are named explicitly in the appendix (Model-A-lite, Model-B-fallback), 2) emergency fallback allowed for P0/P1 outages with automatic failover and 48-hour notification, 3) we maintain the same KMS binding but a reduced telemetry window (tokens logged for 24 hours only) during emergency fallback.

I'm also proposing a small amendment to the Order Form: add a row in the hosting table for "Fallback routing: allowed under Emergency Failover only; details in DPA appendix". I put a redline in OrderForm_2026-11-30.pdf.

DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.com/secure?envelopeId=ABC123

Ben
Sr. Contracts Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sccs-fallback-draft.md, OrderForm_2026-11-30.pdf

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. Novus Legal reviewed the DPA appendix and has two small asks: (1) make explicit that emergency fallback must be used only when Redwood's primary EU region is unreachable, and (2) add a short table that maps each named fallback model to a data handling classification (e.g., Model-A-lite = transient inference only; no long-term storage). They are otherwise comfortable with the 48-hour notification and the 24-hour telemetry window during emergency fallback.

Can you incorporate the table and confirm we can get the updated documents by Thursday (2026-12-17) so the procurement team can close next week?

Claire
